# Execution plan: <outcome>

Template only. Copy to `docs/plans/` and replace placeholders before committing an actual plan.

- Execution state: active / blocked / completed / superseded
- Issue and implementation PR:
- Baseline commit and working branch:
- Last meaningful update:
- Responsible collaborator / agent:

## Outcome and acceptance

Who needs this, what changes for them, and how will each acceptance criterion be demonstrated?

## Context and boundaries

Required source files, contracts and decisions; in-scope and out-of-scope work; compatibility/data/visual constraints; unresolved questions and current authorization boundaries.

## Steps and checkpoints

Small verifiable implementation steps, dependencies and the check/evidence required at each checkpoint.

## Decisions and progress

Dated facts, rationale for material choices, changed assumptions, completed work and concrete blockers. No private conversation or hidden reasoning.

## Verification and delivery

| Criterion | Command or inspection | Actual result | Evidence / pending work |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Replace with a real criterion | | Not run | |

Record final diff review, docs/generated outputs, commit/PR and deployment only if applicable. Failed or unrun checks stay explicit.

## Resume / follow-up

Exact next action, remaining work, useful commands and any replacement plan or follow-up issue. On completion, summarize the delivered outcome and durable lessons.
